notes: Curated eval for customer-facing QBR and EBR packs built around customer outcomes. Near-misses keep internal account briefs and one-off executive meetings on adjacent skills.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build customer-facing QBR and EBR deliverables that align customer goals, business outcomes, decisions, risks, and next steps.
Please prepare a quarterly business review or executive business review, with an optional internal prep appendix for that same review.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable qbr ebr and label anything that still needs confirmation.
Write the customer-facing quarterly review deck for Acme with an outcome scorecard, last quarter's commitments, and a joint next-quarter plan. Keep internal churn notes out of the customer pack.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please build concise, decision-ready account briefs for account reviews, account planning, renewal or expansion reviews, and customer meeting preparation.
Prepare Thursday's internal account review brief for Acme. One decision: do we assign a new executive sponsor before we send commercial paper.
Please build a concise, decision-oriented executive briefing and meeting plan for a strategic customer or commercial meeting, negotiation, escalation, or internal alignment on that same decision.
Prepare our CRO's pre-read for tomorrow's 30-minute meeting with Acme's COO. We need one ask, a fallback if they will not move, and talking points.
Please build reusable renewal and expansion motions for customer-facing teams across a segment or book of business.

output_structure_checks.name: qbr-ebr-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: States review type, audience, and the decisions or commitments requested in the room.

output_structure_checks.name: qbr-ebr-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Centers the narrative on customer outcomes and goals, not vendor activity volume.

output_structure_checks.name: qbr-ebr-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Includes an outcome scorecard with source, as-of date, and attribution or acceptance status, or an explicit gap.

output_structure_checks.name: qbr-ebr-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a joint action plan with customer-side and internal owners and an agreement state.

output_structure_checks.name: qbr-ebr-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps internal risk language out of the customer-facing pack unless internal mode was requested.
